name: Znect CI Bridge
description: Experimental read-only MCP bridge between a compatible client, Cloudflare Workers, and CircleCI build information.

tested: GitHub Actions Ubuntu: TypeScript typecheck and Wrangler dry-run

permissions: Network access to the configured Cloudflare Worker and approved CircleCI API endpoints
Read-only CircleCI project/build data using a secret token
Bearer authentication for the MCP endpoint
security_controls: Bearer authentication for /mcp with fixed-length digest comparison
Fixed CircleCI project path and read-only GET requests
CircleCI redirect rejection and 15-second outbound request timeouts; artifact redirects are manually revalidated
HTTPS artifact URL allowlist and default-port restriction
Per-action and aggregate log output character limits
Configured Worker secrets redacted from returned logs
Secrets supplied through Cloudflare Worker Secrets
CircleCI API JSON response body size ceiling
Cloudflare Rate Limiting binding: 60 authenticated MCP requests per 60 seconds per Cloudflare location
Rate-limit key is a SHA-256 digest of the configured MCP token; raw token is not used as the key
Fail-closed HTTP 503 when rate limiting is missing or unavailable
Best-effort pattern redaction for common Bearer/Basic, GitHub/GitLab/Slack, Stripe, Google, npm, AWS, JWT, PEM, and key/value credential formats
limitations: Cloudflare deployment and end-to-end MCP behavior not verified
CircleCI connectivity and log retrieval not verified
CircleCI API v1.1 is legacy and requires a migration plan
Only configured Worker secrets are explicitly redacted; other upstream secrets may appear in logs
Wrangler/workerd unsupported in the current Android ARM64 Termux environment
Cloudflare built-in rate limiting is approximate and per location, not a strict global limit
Failed authentication attempts are not covered by the authenticated per-token rate limit
Rate-limit namespace ID must be unique within the user's Cloudflare account
Heuristic log-secret redaction cannot guarantee detection of all custom or encoded credentials
